# Nosskey SDK

> Nosskey derives Nostr keys from passkeys (WebAuthn PRF). A Nostr web client can add "Log in with Nosskey" by embedding the hosted signing iframe at https://nosskey.app/#/iframe through the `nosskey-iframe` npm package, which exposes a NIP-07 compatible API.

To add Nosskey passkey login to a client, read the integration guide below first. It is self-contained: rules, copy-paste code, CSS, a login modal that offers NIP-07 and Nosskey side by side, and a verification checklist.

## Integration guides

- [Nosskey iframe login guide for AI agents](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ocknamo/nosskey-sdk/main/docs/llms/nosskey-iframe-login.md): step-by-step instructions to add "Log in with Nosskey" alongside the app's other login methods (the example uses NIP-07)
- [Nosskey iframe login guide for AI agents (ja)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ocknamo/nosskey-sdk/main/docs/llms/nosskey-iframe-login.ja.md): Japanese version of the guide above, with identical code blocks
- [iframe integration guide (en)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ocknamo/nosskey-sdk/main/docs/en/iframe-integration.en.md): human-oriented reference for `NosskeyIframeClient` (options, storage partitioning, errors)
- [iframe integration guide (ja, master)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ocknamo/nosskey-sdk/main/docs/ja/iframe-integration.ja.md): Japanese original of the guide above

## Package reference

- [nosskey-iframe README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ocknamo/nosskey-sdk/main/packages/nosskey-iframe/README.md): client and host quick starts, API exports, deployment checklist
- [nosskey-iframe protocol](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ocknamo/nosskey-sdk/main/packages/nosskey-iframe/src/protocol.ts): postMessage message types, error codes, consent-gated methods
- [nosskey-iframe client](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ocknamo/nosskey-sdk/main/packages/nosskey-iframe/src/client.ts): `NosskeyIframeClient` source

## Reference implementations

These apps are useful for the overlay, the lazy client singleton and the login modal layout. Some of their other patterns break the rules in the integration guide: combine polls `getPublicKey()` on tab switch and always overwrites `window.nostr`, and yakitofu destroys the client on logout. Where they differ, follow the guide.

- [combine auth store](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ocknamo/combine/main/src/lib/auth.svelte.ts): production Svelte 5 client using the Nosskey iframe (overlay + MutationObserver)
- [combine window.nostr shim](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ocknamo/combine/main/src/lib/nip07.ts): exposing a minimal NIP-07 provider for embedded widgets
- [yakitofu login modal](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ocknamo/yakitofu/main/yakitofu-app/src/lib/components/LoginModal.svelte): NIP-07 and Nosskey login offered side by side
- [yakitofu signer](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ocknamo/yakitofu/main/yakitofu-app/src/lib/services/signer.ts): picking the signer by login method
- [parent-sample](https://github.com/ocknamo/nosskey-sdk/tree/main/examples/parent-sample): vanilla TypeScript demo, live at https://ocknamo.github.io/nosskey-sdk/

## Optional

- [iframe host internals (en)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ocknamo/nosskey-sdk/main/docs/en/iframe-host.en.md): how nosskey.app serves the iframe (consent, Storage Access API); only needed to self-host a signer
- [nosskey-sdk interface (en)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ocknamo/nosskey-sdk/main/docs/en/nosskey-sdk-interface.en.md): using passkey-derived keys directly without the iframe
- [Nosskey specification (en)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ocknamo/nosskey-sdk/main/docs/en/nosskey-specification.en.md): key derivation design
